explanation: This fires only at D2, when the agent chose a1 and reached S1 by a common transition: 10 late in the episode (around trial 85 and later) and about 9 earlier (8 to 9 before trial 25). It is 0 at every D1 and GO step, and 0 at D2 for every other outcome (a1 rare to S2, or any a2 choice, common or rare), whatever the reward history.
